title: [MOCK] Sparse Routing Adapters for Low-Resource Translation
abstract: We propose Sparse Routing Adapters (SRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting multilingual translation models to low-resource language pairs. On WMT14 En-De and two low-resource pairs, SRA improves BLEU over LoRA while training 40% fewer parameters.

title: [MOCK] A Position on Evaluation Practices for Code Generation Benchmarks
abstract: This position paper discusses how code generation benchmarks are constructed and reported.

title: [MOCK] Curriculum Sampling for Graph Contrastive Learning
abstract: We introduce a curriculum sampling strategy for graph contrastive learning. Our strategy improves node classification accuracy on Cora and PubMed.

title: [MOCK] Scaling Laws for Retrieval-Augmented Agents
abstract: We study how the performance of retrieval-augmented agents scales with the size of the retrieval corpus.
